components.css: .ds-card{max-width:440px;color:var(--ink, #252b20);font-family:var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif);background:var(--paper, #faf9f6)}.ds-card-frame{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1.65;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--radius,12px)}.ds-card-photo-link{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden}.ds-card-photo{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .5s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.2,1)}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo{transform:scale(1.035)}.ds-card-label{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:4px;background:var(--paper, #faf9f6);font-size:12px;pointer-events:none}.ds-card-save{position:absolute;top:11px;right:11px;width:40px;height:40px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:50%;background:var(--paper, #faf9f6);color:var(--ink, #252b20);cursor:pointer;transition:background .2s,transform .2s}.ds-card-save:hover{background:#e3e9d7;transform:scale(1.06)}.ds-card-info{padding:15px 1px 0}.ds-card-price{margin:0;font-size:20px;font-weight:600;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.4;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-card-title{margin:3px 0 0;font-family:var(--serif, 'Kadel Serif', Georgia, serif);font-size:30px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.2}.ds-card-title a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-card-title a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-thickness:1px}.ds-card-location{margin:4px 0 0;color:var(--muted, #62675d);font-size:13px}.ds-card-facts{display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:17px;font-size:13px}.ds-card-title a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive, #344427);outline-offset:4px}.ds-card-save:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive, #344427);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-card-photo,.ds-card-save{transition:none}.ds-card:hover .ds-card-photo{transform:none}}

components.css: .ds-detail-panel{max-width:410px;padding:28px;border-radius:var(--radius,12px);background:var(--surface, #f0f1e9);color:var(--ink, #252b20);font-family:var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif)}.ds-detail-price{margin:0;font-size:34px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:-.035em;line-height:1.2}.ds-detail-subtitle{margin:7px 0 24px;font-size:12px;color:var(--muted, #62675d)}.ds-detail-primary,.ds-detail-outline{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:16px;min-height:48px;padding:12px 24px;border-radius:7px;font-family:var(--sans, 'DM Sans', sans-serif);font-size:14px;font-weight:500;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none;cursor:pointer;transition:background .18s,transform .18s;width:100%;margin-top:10px}.ds-detail-primary{border:0;background:var(--olive, #344427);color:var(--white,#fff)}.ds-detail-primary:hover{background:var(--olive-hover,#25351b)}.ds-detail-outline{border:1px solid #cbd0c1;background:transparent;color:var(--ink, #252b20)}.ds-detail-outline:hover{background:#e9eddf}.ds-detail-primary:active,.ds-detail-outline:active{transform:scale(.98)}.ds-detail-note{margin:11px 0 0;font-size:11px;line-height:1.7;text-align:center;color:var(--muted, #62675d)}.ds-detail-meta{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;margin-top:25px;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #d0d6c4;font-size:11px;color:var(--muted, #62675d)}.ds-detail-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive, #344427);outline-offset:4px}.ds-detail-outline:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--olive, #344427);outline-offset:4px}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-detail-primary,.ds-detail-outline{transition:none}}

narrative.overview:
Kadel Builders borrows the calm of a residential architecture practice: generous warm paper, deep olive controls, considered photographic crops, and an editorial serif. Homes lead the experience. The interface gives prices, places, and practical facts enough space to be read without competing with the photography.

Public browsing, property details, saved homes, and sign-in share this welcoming editorial character. Administration uses the same palette and controls with precise sans-serif headings, compact tables, visible statuses, and direct forms. This is one identity with density adjusted to the task.
keyCharacteristics: Warm, quiet surfaces with olive action emphasis.
Large serif public headings and clear sans-serif controls.
Rounded photographs, restrained borders, and flat cards.
Responsive reading order and browser-native navigation.
Practical, denser administration with explicit states.

rules.name: The Olive Action Rule
rules.body: Use deep olive for an action or selected state; let photography and warm paper carry the public page.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Use the serif for public editorial hierarchy and the sans-serif for controls, facts, prices, and administrative hierarchy.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep resting content flat; reserve lift for modal and navigation overlays.

dos: **Do** give home photography, prices, places, and facts a clear reading order.
**Do** pair editorial serif headings with precise sans-serif controls and administrative headings.
**Do** use olive for primary actions, selection, and visible keyboard focus.
**Do** keep cards flat and use pale olive panels for grouped actions.
**Do** preserve native anchors, semantic labels, explicit statuses, and pending saves through sign-in.
**Do** identify demonstration inventory and illustrative photography where the application does so.
donts: **Don't** add enquiry actions to property cards or the browse page.
**Don't** replace the established warm paper and olive identity with unrelated accent colors.
**Don't** add shadows to resting property cards or decorative metrics to administration.
**Don't** use color alone to communicate listing status or remove visible keyboard focus.
**Don't** apply public display typography to the dense admin hierarchy.
**Don't** add travel animation when reduced motion is requested.
